releaseNotes: V979 adds a deterministic No-Criteria semantic neutralizer after LLM inference and before the unchanged Grounding validator.

When Grounding rejects a condition_criteria sentence while deterministic Condition is NOT_EVALUATED with No Criteria, ICEops reduces only the rejected sentence, then validates the entire answer again with the same AiGroundingValidator.

Known operational coupling such as '8/8 ports are connected and in a healthy state' is reduced to the supported connection fact; other rejected condition-evaluation lines are replaced with the deterministic NOT_EVALUATED/no-criteria statement and its deterministic Evidence ID.

Neutralization is bounded to four rejected condition_criteria lines per response and runs both before the existing one-time corrective retry and after a retry response. Any remaining Grounding failure is still BLOCKED.

AiGroundingValidator, deterministic evaluation, Safe Disconnect, communication, Polling/MAX, PDO/ISDU, Studio Runtime, HMI read-only, AI Data Library, and Signal Tower hardware-control paths are unchanged.

en: Added deterministic No-Criteria semantic neutralization before the unchanged Grounding validator.
Only a sentence already rejected as condition_criteria can be reduced; the entire answer is revalidated afterward.
Operational facts such as 'connected' are preserved while unsupported health/normality meaning is removed; unreducible condition claims fall back to the deterministic NOT_EVALUATED statement.
The existing one-time AI corrective retry remains available only if deterministic neutralization does not produce a fully grounded answer.
ko: 기존 Grounding Validator 앞에 No Criteria 전용 결정론적 Semantic Neutralizer를 추가했습니다.
Validator가 condition_criteria로 이미 거부한 문장만 축소하며, 수정 후 전체 AI 답변을 동일한 Validator로 다시 검증합니다.
'connected' 같은 운영 사실은 유지하고 근거 없는 정상/건강 의미만 제거하며, 안전하게 축소할 수 없는 Condition 평가는 결정론적 NOT_EVALUATED 문장으로 치환합니다.
결정론적 중화 후에도 Grounding이 실패할 때만 기존 1회 AI 교정 Retry를 사용하며, 최종 실패는 계속 BLOCKED 처리합니다.
ja: 既存の Grounding Validator の前に No Criteria 専用の決定論的 Semantic Neutralizer を追加しました。
Validator が condition_criteria として拒否した文だけを縮約し、その後に回答全体を同じ Validator で再検証します。
接続などの運用事実は保持し、根拠のない正常・健全の意味だけを除去します。安全に縮約できない Condition 評価は決定論的 NOT_EVALUATED 文へ置換します。
決定論的中和後も失敗する場合のみ既存の1回の AI 修正 Retry を使用し、最終失敗は引き続き BLOCKED です。
zh-CN: 在现有 Grounding Validator 之前增加了仅用于 No Criteria 的确定性 Semantic Neutralizer。
只缩减已经被 Validator 判定为 condition_criteria 的句子，随后用同一个 Validator 重新验证整段回答。
保留连接等运行事实，只移除无依据的健康/正常含义；无法安全缩减的 Condition 判断会替换为确定性的 NOT_EVALUATED 说明。
只有确定性中和后仍未通过时才使用现有的一次 AI 纠正 Retry，最终失败仍保持 BLOCKED。
de: Vor dem unveränderten Grounding Validator wurde ein deterministischer No-Criteria Semantic Neutralizer ergänzt.
Nur Sätze, die bereits als condition_criteria abgelehnt wurden, werden reduziert; anschließend wird die gesamte Antwort erneut mit demselben Validator geprüft.

Betriebsfakten wie die Verbindung bleiben erhalten, während unbelegte Gesundheits-/Normalitätsaussagen entfernt werden; nicht sicher reduzierbare Condition-Aussagen werden durch die deterministische NOT_EVALUATED-Aussage ersetzt.
Der bestehende einmalige AI-Korrektur-Retry wird nur verwendet, wenn die deterministische Neutralisierung nicht vollständig grounded ist; endgültige Fehler bleiben BLOCKED.
es: Se añadió un Semantic Neutralizer determinista para No Criteria antes del Grounding Validator sin modificarlo.
Solo se reduce una frase que el Validator ya rechazó como condition_criteria; después se vuelve a validar la respuesta completa con el mismo Validator.

Se conservan hechos operativos como la conexión y se elimina únicamente el significado no sustentado de salud/normalidad; una evaluación de Condition que no pueda reducirse con seguridad se sustituye por la declaración determinista NOT_EVALUATED.
El reintento correctivo de AI existente se usa solo si la neutralización determinista aún no logra una respuesta completamente grounded; el fallo final continúa como BLOCKED.
